_note: R39.1 'What's new' popup: newest first. The popup shows once per BUILD (the first entry should match js/config.js BUILD). Plain language for players.

entries.title: Tester links and What's new
items: This 'What's new' window: it pops up once after each update. Reopen it any time from 📂 Saves.
Playtesters can open a special tester link to get a 🧪 Tester badge and a quick Feedback button.

entries.title: Markets you can read
items: New 📊 Market Board at the top of the Map: the best town to sell each thing you own, and the cheapest place to buy.
Prices now show ▲ (high) or ▼ (low) with a short reason, like 'they want it' or 'flooded: you sold a lot here'.
Towns show what they're Short of and Flooded with.
New town events: shortages (a good pays 1.5×) and gluts (a good pays little), lasting 10–20 days.
The Bag tab shows your best three places to sell.

entries.title: Save slots
items: Keep up to 5 dynasties side by side from the new 📂 Saves screen. Each has its own Legacy.
Rename, delete (with undo), import and export each slot. A bar shows how much storage you're using.

entries.title: Free automation basics
items: Basic automation is now free from the start: auto-tending, family orders, kids' tutoring, courtship and a few quotas.
Upgrades make automation faster or bigger. Legacy you already spent on the old upgrades was refunded.
Legacy upgrades moved to their own 🏛️ screen in the top bar.

entries.title: Talents
items: Family members can earn talents by doing things, like Tracker's Eye for hunters or Haggler for traders.
Each talent gives a small bonus. They show on the Character screen.
